docs.title: Data Science MCP - A2A | AG-UI | MCP
Overview
docs.text:
Data Science MCP MCP Server + A2A Agent

Data Science MCP Server — Model training, evaluation, and evolution tools for agentic ML workflows. Integrates with agent-utilities IModelEvolver (CONCEPT:AHE-3.15).

This repository is actively maintained - Contributions are welcome!

docs.title: Using as an MCP Server
docs.text: The MCP Server can be run in two modes: stdio (for local testing) or http (for networked access).

docs.title: Environment Variables
docs.text:
• DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_URL: The URL of the target service.
  • DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_TOKEN: The API token or access token.

docs.title: Run A2A Server
docs.text:
export DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_URL="http://localhost:8080"
export DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_TOKEN="your_token"
data-science-agent --provider openai --model-id gpt-4o --api-key sk-...

docs.title: Deploy with Docker Compose
docs.text:
services:
  data-science-mcp:
    image: knucklessg1/data-science-mcp:latest
    environment:
      - HOST=0.0.0.0
      - PORT=8000
      - TRANSPORT=http
      - DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_URL=http://your-service:8080
      - DATA_SCIENCE_MCP_TOKEN=your_token
    ports:
      - 8000:8000

docs.title: Configure mcp.json for AI Integration (e.g. Claude Desktop)
Install Python Package
docs.text:
python -m pip install data-science-mcp

uv pip install data-science-mcp

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
This project follows the standardized agent-package pattern:

data-science-mcp/
├── data_science_mcp/        # Source code
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── agent_server.py      # Entry point (create_graph_agent_server)
│   ├── api_client.py        # REST/GraphQL API wrapper
│   └── mcp_server.py        # FastMCP tool definitions
├── tests/                   # Test suite
├── docs/                    # Documentation
├── pyproject.toml           # Package metadata
├── mcp_config.json          # MCP server configuration
├── main_agent.json          # Agent identity & system prompt
└── Dockerfile               # Container deployment
